$comment: The one contract of the AI boundary. The Rust shell (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands/ai.rs) and the frontend (apps/desktop/src/lib/ai.ts) both read this file, and neither names an event, a payload field, a command or an argument anywhere else. Each event carries the prefix that names it. The value of a field names the type of the field by example: an empty text is a string and false is a boolean.
